verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document a guided US A2P 10DLC brand or campaign registration flow, nor any 10DLC approval-status view. The closest items are toll-free verification in the Console with status review and Regulatory Bundles, which are different compliance programs and earn no credit here. Community comments only confirm that Twilio enforces 10DLC registration, not that it walks users through it or shows status.

support.subject: As a founder, the product walks me through US A2P 10DLC brand and campaign registration and shows the approval status
